Inspect all 244 individual sprite states

Some original slots are deliberately empty. Tiny bullets, sonic waves and destination-distortion masks are explicitly marked as analytic effects. These cards show the asset itself, not the live engine’s compositing or distortion.

Textures are authored at four times the native resolution. “Magnify units” enlarges those same textures for inspection; it adds no new detail. State cycling previews saved poses and building states at a convenient inspection speed, not the original game clock. Neutral materials keep their colour when the faction changes.
